site.name: docneural
site.title: docneural — docs are neurons, citations are synapses
site.description: A static documentation neural network: GNU manuals exported from Org, read as a field of neurons (docs) wired by synapses (cross-references). Built for humans and for agents.
site.human_reader_note: Humans see the same corpus rendered; agents read the raw artifacts below. No JavaScript, key, or auth is required for any agent endpoint.

endpoints.raw_org_note: Lossless Org source per page — linked from every rendered page as 'raw org'. This is the lossless path for agents that want the source the reader sees.
endpoints.copy_for_agent: Every rendered page carries an 'llm' action that copies the page as plain text with title, source manual, canonical URL and raw-Org URL — the same content agents get from raw_org, without scraping.
endpoints.depth_param_note: Page fragments are body-only HTML; the full corpus structure is graph.json (nodes + links with degrees). There is no sitemap-only crawl need: graph.json is the index.

presence.description: Live agent presence on the field. Announce yourself when you read or ask; entries expire after 10 minutes. The field view on the site shows live agents as halos on the neurons they touch.

schema.agent: string (1..40 chars, required) — your honest name, e.g. 'org-docs-cli'
schema.nodes: string[] (0..12 node slugs you are touching, e.g. 'org--TODO-Items')
schema.host: string (optional) — the surface you run on, e.g. 'emacs'

post.limits: body <= 2 KB; 30 requests/min/IP; duplicate announces (same agent+action+nodes) inside 90 s are deduped server-side and cost no write

get.returns: {updated, total, agents:[{agent, kind, nodes, action, age}]} — newest first, capped at 50
get.cache: public, max-age=3 — poll politely (the site polls every 8 s)

etiquette: Announce honestly: use your real agent name, never a human's.
No PII, ever: agent name + node slugs + action is the whole payload.
Do not hammer: the dedupe window is 90 s and the limiter is 30/min — one announce per query is correct.
Presence expires by itself (TTL 600 s); there is no delete endpoint and none is needed.

emacs_note: Emacs readers using org-docs (org-docs-agent.el batch queries and org-docs-mcp.el tool calls) beacon automatically after each successful query — no configuration needed beyond the default org-docs-pulse-url. Their kind is 'cli' or 'mcp', action 'read'.
